nodes.description: Anakinra is recombinant IL-1 receptor antagonist (IL-1Ra). It is recorded here as PROTEIN_REPLACEMENT in the specific sense that ELF4 normally sustains the endogenous IL-1Ra gene Il1rn, so its loss lowers IL-1Ra; anakinra supplies that antagonist. Fevers and ulcers have responded to IL-1 blockade.

nodes.description: ELF4 is a transcriptional rheostat on inflammation: it sustains anti-inflammatory genes such as Il1rn and limits inflammation-amplifier genes including S100A8, Lcn2 and Trem1. Loss of ELF4 removes this restraint.
